[[File:Kyle Heuer DecipherCon 2002 PANA0107.jpg|thumb|right|260px|Kyle Heuer at DecipherCon 2002. Photo: Decipher.]]
'''Kyle Heuer''' won the October 1996 Sacramento Regional hosted by [[Paul Hegyi]].<ref name="decsq-hegyipaul">[http://www.decipher.com/volunteers/squadrons/players/hegyipaul.html Star Wars CCG Squadrons: Red 18 profile], decipher.com. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20001212115300/http://decipher.com:80/volunteers/squadrons/players/hegyipaul.html Internet Archive]</ref><ref name="dec96">[http://www.decipher.com/swccg/tournaments/regionalfinals.html Regional Championship Finalists], Decipher (1996). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/19961121232352/http://www.decipher.com/swccg/tournaments/regionalfinals.html Internet Archive]</ref> He was a Decipher-era [[Squadron Members|Squadron Member]], listed as Red 7 from Decipher Inc., later Rogue Leader.<ref name="smlist">[https://www.geocities.ws/plarathas/SMs.html Squadron Members], Corellian Engineering Corporation fan site (geocities.ws/plarathas). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261009142705/https://www.geocities.ws/plarathas/SMs.html Internet Archive]</ref>

== Jedi Knights TCG ==
Heuer is credited on Decipher's [[Jedi Knights Trading Card Game]] team. As Product Champion Coordinator he led the Product Champions' promotion of the game and was its video reporter.<ref name="jkrules">[http://www.decipher.com/jediknights/rules/jediknightsrules.txt ''Jedi Knights'' Trading Card Game rulebook (credits)], Decipher (2001). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20010820125115/http://www.decipher.com:80/jediknights/rules/jediknightsrules.txt Internet Archive]</ref><ref name="jkpersonae" />
